name: thermal-break-refuses-memory-only-item-destroys-low-reserve-item
notes: Thermal Break: the destroy filter ('memory cost 0 or reserve cost 3 or less') called CardMemoryCost($cardID) and the nonexistent CardReserveCost(): resolving it with any item on the field was a fatal. Now Scepter of Lumina (memory cost 1, no reserve cost) is refused and Forest Cake (reserve cost 2) is destroyed.

rulesClauses: Destroy target item or weapon with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 3 or less.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated filter for Thermal Break called CardMemoryCost($cardID) (it takes an object) and CardReserveCost() (does not exist): a fatal as soon as an item or weapon was on the field. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with ItemLowCostMatches() (explicit memory cost 0, or a real reserve cost of at most 3), including Thermal Break's activation prereq.
